+---|  Keyboard chart                                                      |---+
|  C|  1–7       Switch view                                               |   |
|  f|  j/k ↑/↓   Move through the active list                              |   |
|  >|  enter / i Inspect the selected resource                             |   |
|   |  space     Toggle selection (images/containers)                      |   |
|   |  shift+↓/↑ Extend selection                                          |   |
|   |  /         Filter images, containers, or volumes                     |   |
|   |  o         Cycle image name / size / age sort                        |   |
|   |  p         Pull image · pause container                              |   |
|   |  r         Run image · restart container                             |   |
|   |  x / s     Start / stop container                                    |   |
|   |  K         Kill container (confirmation)                             |   |
|   |  d         Remove resource (never forced)                            |   |
|   |  l         Container logs (follow, pause, filter, save)              |   |
|   |  e         Exec a shell in a running container                       |   |
|   |  y         Copy equivalent CLI command                               |   |
